groups.title: Drinks & flavour
groups.lede: Cocktails and coffee treated as measured systems: ratios, dilution, compounds and balance made explicit.

projects.name: MixLab
projects.desc: Explore drink ingredient combinations and see their nutrition, active compounds and safety flags.

projects.name: CoffeeLab
projects.desc: A small visual lab for building coffee drinks: dose, ratio, grind and time.

groups.title: Cooking
groups.lede: Recipes as experiments, and a cooking-science simulator that predicts what heat and method will do before you start.

projects.name: cook
projects.desc: A simple food blog: healthy, tasty meals built from basic building blocks.

projects.name: umami
projects.desc: A pre-cook simulator: pick ingredients and a method to see flavour, texture and nutrition changes.

groups.title: Food safety & allergens
groups.lede: Point a phone at a food label and get an allergen and safety verdict in seconds.

projects.name: SafeBite
projects.desc: An installable, mobile-first scanner that reads ingredient labels and flags allergens.

parts.name: SafeBite backend
parts.kind: Apps Script service that reads each label with an AI model

groups.title: Diet tracking
groups.lede: Set up your usual foods once, tick off what you ate, and the totals follow.

projects.name: Trophe
projects.desc: Your food on autopilot: a daily routine of foods with nutrition worked out for you.

groups.title: Multisensory eating
groups.lede: Wire a fork and spoon to a Kiwrious conductivity sensor and every bite plays a note.

projects.name: Soundbites
projects.desc: Turns the conductivity of each bite into pitch, so a salad becomes an instrument.

yearsNote: Years from each project's git history; umami and SafeBite have no repository, so their file dates are used.
thumbsNote: Cards with an `og` page load that page's current og:image live through the Worker (/api/og) over a shared fallback; cook, Trophe, umami and Soundbites have no share image, so they use screenshots.
cardsNote: Cards show only things people use. Backends and earlier versions are listed as parts of their product (hover the parts chip).
